title: Cheat Sheets
description: Contract for /learn's technique cheat sheet, generated from the technique docs (see scripts/build_cheatsheets.py's module docstring). `page` on a signal row marks a signal whose technique has no dedicated technique page (heap, Boyer-Moore voting, cyclic sort, two heaps, quickselect), so the site can skip linking it.

signals.description: The landing 'Signal -> technique' table, from intuition_cheatsheet.md.

decisionTree.description: The 'Decision tree' bullet list from intuition_cheatsheet.md (shape -> cue -> technique), rooted at one inner node.

see.description: What you see in the prompt (the 'signal').

reach.description: The technique id to reach for when this signal fires (a techniques[].id), unless `page` is false, in which case this is the technique's text label (no dedicated page exists).

note.description: The short parenthetical/clarifying note from the table's 'Reach for' cell. Empty string when the table carries none.

page.description: false when `reach` names a technique with no dedicated technique page (single-trick techniques: heap, Boyer-Moore voting, cyclic sort, two heaps, quickselect). Omitted (treated as true) whenever a page exists.

id.description: Slug of the technique doc's filename (underscores -> hyphens).

name.description: The doc's H1, with a trailing ' Patterns' dropped.

tier.description: From techniques.yml (defaults to 'core' when the matched entry carries no tier key).

whenToUse.description: One sentence, extracted verbatim/trimmed from the doc. 'TODO' when the doc states no single when-to-use sentence.

signals.description: The technique's own recognition-signal bullets (distinct from the top-level signals table). Empty when the doc has none.

feature.description: The one feature that picks this technique over its nearest neighbour. 'TODO' when no doc states a discriminator.

pitfalls.description: Verbatim/trimmed bullets from the doc's pitfalls/gotchas section. Empty when the doc has none.

docUrl.description: Link to the full technique doc on GitHub (main branch).

technique.description: The neighbouring technique's id (a techniques[].id) when it has a dedicated page, else its plain text label.

because.description: The doc-stated reason this technique is not the one named.

page.description: false when `technique` names a technique with no dedicated page (single-trick techniques: heap, Boyer-Moore voting, cyclic sort, two heaps, quickselect). Omitted (treated as true) whenever a page exists.

title.description: The variant/template heading, as given in the doc.

when.description: Optional: the doc-stated condition this variant applies under.

code.description: The variant's python code, copied verbatim from the doc's fenced code block (real newlines, original indentation).

why.description: The doc's own why-clause. 'TODO' for all three fields when the doc states no complexity for this variant — never computed by the generator/extractor.

lcNumber.description: LeetCode problem number, as given in the doc's Practice/Problems section.

decisionNode.description: One bullet of the decision tree: either a leaf (reaches a technique) or an inner node (asks a further question). Never both.

label.description: The shape/cue this node asks about. A label ending in '?' is a question; the site infers this, there is no separate 'kind' field.
The cue that reaches this technique.

reach.description: The technique id to reach for (a techniques[].id), unless `page` is false, in which case this is the technique's text label (no dedicated page exists).

reachLabel.description: The author's link/bold text for the technique as written in the doc — e.g. 'DFS postorder', 'sort by start, sweep' — shown by the site as the leaf's link text; `reach` stays the id/route key.

note.description: The short parenthetical note after the arrow. Empty string when the bullet carries none.

page.description: Present and false when `reach` names a technique with no dedicated page. Omitted (treated as true) whenever a page exists.
